description: Chunk + embed an upstream corpus into a versioned ChromaDB snapshot. Each materialization = new immutable snapshot; registers a new dynamic partition for downstream.

outputs.description: Dict with snapshot_path, snapshot_id, chunk_count, dimension, corpus_hash, dynamic_partition_name

upstream_asset_key.label: Upstream Asset Key
upstream_asset_key.description: Upstream document_corpus asset key (supports slash-paths for cross-loc).

snapshot_root_dir.label: Snapshot Root Dir
snapshot_root_dir.description: Directory that holds all snapshots. Each materialization writes a new subdir.

embedder_provider.label: Embedder Provider
embedder_provider.description: 'chromadb_default' (local ONNX MiniLM, no API key) | 'openai' (needs api_key_env_var)

embedder_model.label: Embedder Model
embedder_model.description: Provider-specific model name. Defaults: chromadb_default=all-MiniLM-L6-v2, openai=text-embedding-3-small

api_key_env_var.label: Api Key Env Var
api_key_env_var.description: For openai provider: env var holding the API key (e.g. OPENAI_API_KEY)

collection_name.label: Collection Name
collection_name.description: ChromaDB collection name inside each snapshot

dynamic_partition_name.label: Dynamic Partition Name
dynamic_partition_name.description: Name of the DynamicPartitionsDefinition used to track snapshot ids. Downstream assets bind to a specific snapshot by partition key = snapshot_id, so rollback is 'materialize downstream against the older partition' — no rebuild.

freshness_max_lag_minutes.label: Freshness Max Lag Minutes
freshness_max_lag_minutes.description: Freshness policy: max lag before this snapshot is considered stale.

freshness_cron.label: Freshness Cron
freshness_cron.description: Cron schedule for the freshness policy.
